# sentry_team_member (Resource)

Puts an organization member on a team. The member keeps the team role Sentry gives them by default; team roles are not managed yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sentry_organization_member" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
}

resource "sentry_team_member" "backend_jane" {
  team_id   = sentry_team.backend.id
  member_id = data.sentry_organization_member.jane.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String) Organization member ID, e.g. `sentry_organization_member.example.id` or `data.sentry_organization_member.example.id`. It is not the user's ID.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team, e.g. `sentry_team.example.id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<team_id>/<member_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <team slug or ID>/<organization member ID>.
terraform import sentry_team_member.backend_jane backend/57377908164
```
